title: IN WHICH PASSEPARTOUT TALKS RATHER MORE, PERHAPS, THAN IS PRUDENT
summary_hover: Detective Fix subtly interrogates an unsuspecting Passepartout, confirming his suspicions about Fogg, and subsequently boards the Mongolia in pursuit.
summary_detail: On the quay at Suez, Detective Fix befriends Passepartout and pumps him for information. Hearing about Phileas Fogg's sudden departure from London, his large stash of brand new banknotes, and his supposed eighty-day journey around the world, Fix is entirely convinced Fogg is the bank robber. Fix wires London for an arrest warrant to be sent to Bombay, takes leave of the consul, and boards the Mongolia.
